title: OTC index option term sheet extraction schema, v1 (v0.2 CS3)
description: Same contract as termsheet_v1: every field EXTRACTED with a verbatim citation or DECLARED_ABSENT. product_type otc_option. Cross-field relations are deterministic comparator rules listed under `relations`.

fields.name: buyer
fields.description: Legal name of the option buyer (Party B).

fields.name: seller
fields.description: Legal name of the option seller (Party A).

fields.name: underlyings
fields.description: Bloomberg ticker(s) of the underlying index, e.g. ['BVERSA10'].

fields.name: strike_level_pct
fields.description: Strike Level as percent of the Initial Index Level.

fields.name: automatic_exercise
fields.description: True if Automatic Exercise is applicable.

fields.name: premium_pct
fields.description: Premium as percent of the Notional Amount.

fields.name: premium_amount
fields.description: Premium amount in currency, numeric, as printed.

fields.name: cash_settlement_days
fields.description: Number of Currency Business Days after the Valuation Date on which cash settlement is paid ('Three' -> 3).

fields.name: calculation_agent
fields.description: Calculation Agent as named ('Party A' or a legal name).

relations.name: premium_arithmetic
relations.description: premium_pct × notional must equal premium_amount within one cent, on the term sheet AND on the booking. A booked premium computed off the wrong notional violates it.

history.note: Initial; fields from V2-CHANGES CS3 and the approved OP-2026-0114 template.
